en.headline: Happy Valley estate pool closed over suspected fake lifeguard certificate
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department ordered the immediate closure of a private swimming pool after a lifeguard’s credentials failed to match official records.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department ordered the immediate closure of a licensed swimming pool at a private housing estate on Ventris Road in Happy Valley after discovering that a lifeguard on duty had used a suspected fraudulent certificate.

Department staff had submitted a batch of lifeguard details to the Hong Kong China Life Saving Society for verification on 5 August. Results received on 6 August showed that the credentials of one attendant who had been on duty the previous day did not match the society’s records. As the attendant’s qualifications were in doubt, the pool was judged not to have provided the legally required number of qualified lifeguards.

The department is considering prosecuting the pool’s licensee and has reported the suspected use of fraudulent documents to police. It has also notified the Property Management Services Authority for parallel follow-up. From January to the end of July the department inspected more than 1,400 private pools and verified the qualifications of about 2,100 lifeguards.

zh.headline: 跑馬地屋苑泳池疑用假救生員證 食環署令即時關閉
zh.dek: 食環署發現跑馬地雲地利道私人屋苑持牌泳池有救生員使用虛假證件，已指令泳池即時關閉，並考慮檢控持牌人。
body: 食物環境衞生署表示，發現跑馬地雲地利道1至5號一私人屋苑的持牌泳池懷疑有救生員使用虛假救生員證件。考慮到當值救生員資格存疑，泳池懷疑未按法例提供足夠合資格救生員，署方已指令有關泳池即時關閉。
食環署人員於8月5日向中國香港拯溺總會核實一批救生員資料，6日收到結果後發現，一名於5日在該泳池當值的救生員，其證件資料與拯溺總會紀錄不符，人員隨即採取行動。
署方正考慮向泳池持牌人提出檢控，並已就事件報警，同時通報物業管理業監管局同步跟進。食環署指，今年1月至7月底期間，人員巡查逾1,400個持牌私人泳池，並核實約2,100名救生員的資格。
